id./param/scenario/cs/b_150_cs_080.pack|cs_: {var:1} told what happened deep in the temple.
"...But that reminds me of an old tale from my grandfather.
"They say the former Luminary carried the Guiding Light on his quest to forge a sword that dispels darkness.
"What you saw must be that scene.
"The floating island where he gathered ore may be the Battleground in the sky.
"The Battleground in the sky? But why would materials for the Sword of Light be in such a place...
"It's an old tale, so I don't know details. It was a floating island with a special metal mine, and a great battle was fought over it.
"I hear the vein was lost after the battle, but maybe...
"Be careful if you go. Not even Watchers have gone near it for hundreds of years, so who knows what it's like.
"Hm, such a place... Then we must go and see for ourselves.
"Oh, and if you forget what to do, come see me again. I'll tell you what my grandfather said.
